overview_description.description: In Your Corner is a marketplace for online counseling and coaching services. Through a secure, HIPAA-compliant platform, their service connects users with a carefully curated team of wellness professionals. By conducting online consultations via video chat, written journals, and even texting sessions, they have transformed traditional therapy into an experience that is low-cost, convenient, and completely confidential.

about_short_description.short_description: In Your Corner is a marketplace for online counseling and coaching services.

product.name: Online Emotional Support
product.description: A platform offering 24/7 emotional support through online chat, connecting users with trained listeners.

product.name: Active Listening Training
product.description: Free online course to train volunteers in active listening, enhancing their ability to provide emotional support.

product.name: Therapeutic Exercises
product.description: Access to simple, proven exercises designed to help users manage stress, anxiety, and other emotional challenges.

product.name: Student Support Services
product.description: Services tailored for educational institutions to support student mental health and retention through anonymous, confidential conversations.

product.name: Employee Assistance Program
product.description: A program offering emotional support to employees, aiming to reduce workplace stress and improve productivity.

product.name: Member Support for Nonprofits
product.description: Support services designed for nonprofit organizations to help their members overcome challenges and build community.
